description_en: Starts a session to log on to a Simple Application Server instance
description_zh: 为轻量应用服务器提供会话登录能力
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open start-terminal-session --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id ace0706b2ac4454d984295a942130000 --command-line ssh_root@192.168.0.000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartTerminalSession

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Simple Application Server instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent list of Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Simple Application Server instance
parameters.help_zh: 轻量应用服务器的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The command to run after the session is started. The command can be up to 512 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 发起会话后，指定执行的命令内容。长度不能超过 512 个字符
parameters.name: command_line
